183        public static void updateBackgroundPickers()
184        {
185                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker;
186                picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
187                picker.add("graphics/backgrounds/background2.jpg", 10);
188                picker.add("graphics/backgrounds/background4.jpg", 10);
189                backgroundsByNebulaType.put(NEBULA_NONE, picker);
190                
191                picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
192                picker.add("graphics/backgrounds/background5.jpg", 10);
193                backgroundsByNebulaType.put(NEBULA_BLUE, picker);
194                
195                picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
196                picker.add("graphics/backgrounds/background6.jpg", 10);
197                backgroundsByNebulaType.put(NEBULA_AMBER, picker);
198                
199                picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
200                picker.add("graphics/backgrounds/background1.jpg", 10);
201                picker.add("graphics/backgrounds/background2.jpg", 10);
202                backgroundsByNebulaType.put(NEBULA_DEFAULT, picker);

345        public StarSystemGenerator(CustomConstellationParams params) {
346                this.params = params;
347                this.constellationAge = params.age;
348                
349                if (this.constellationAge == StarAge.ANY) {
350                        WeightedRandomPicker<StarAge> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarAge>(random);
351                        picker.add(StarAge.AVERAGE);
352                        picker.add(StarAge.OLD);
353                        picker.add(StarAge.YOUNG);
354                        this.constellationAge = picker.pick();
355                }
356                
357                constellationAgeData = (AgeGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(AgeGenDataSpec.class, constellationAge.name(), true);
358        }

364        public void pickNebulaAndBackground() {
365                boolean hasNebula = constellationAgeData.getProbNebula() > random.nextFloat();
366                if (params != null && params.forceNebula) hasNebula = true;
367                
368//              hasNebula = true;
369//              hasNebula = false;
370                
371                nebulaType = NEBULA_NONE;
372                if (hasNebula) {
373                        nebulaType = nebulaTypes.get(constellationAge);
374                }
375                
376                WeightedRandomPicker<String> bgPicker = backgroundsByNebulaType.get(nebulaType);
377                backgroundName = bgPicker.pick();
378        }

383        public Constellation generate() {
384
385//              if (true) {
386//                      params = new CustomConstellationParams(StarAge.OLD);
387//                      params.numStars = 1;
388//                      params.starTypes.add(StarTypes.YELLOW);
389//                      params.systemTypes.add(StarSystemType.SINGLE);
390//                      
391//                      this.constellationAge = params.age;
392//                      constellationAgeData = (AgeGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(AgeGenDataSpec.class, constellationAge.name(), true);
393//              }
394                
395                //random = new Random(12312312312L);
396                
397                //DEBUG = false;
398                
399                lagrangeParentMap = new LinkedHashMap<SectorEntityToken, PlanetAPI>();
400                allNameableEntitiesAdded = new LinkedHashMap<SectorEntityToken, List<SectorEntityToken>>();
401                
402                SectorAPI sector = Global.getSector();
403                Vector2f loc = new Vector2f();
404                if (params != null && params.location != null) {
405                        loc = new Vector2f(params.location);
406                } else {
407                        loc = new Vector2f(sector.getPlayerFleet().getLocation());
408                        loc.x = (int) loc.x;
409                        loc.y = (int) loc.y;
410                }
411                
412                
413                pickNebulaAndBackground();
414                
415                List<StarSystemAPI> systems = new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>();
416                int stars = (int) Math.round(getNormalRandom(1, 7));
417                if (params != null && params.numStars > 0) {
418                        stars = params.numStars;
419                } else if (params != null && params.minStars > 0 && params.maxStars > 0) {
420                        stars = (int) Math.round(getNormalRandom(params.minStars, params.maxStars));
421                }
422                
423//              constellationName = ProcgenUsedNames.pickName(NameGenData.TAG_CONSTELLATION, null);
424//              ProcgenUsedNames.notifyUsed(constellationName.nameWithRomanSuffixIfAny);
425//              Global.getSettings().greekLetterReset();
426                
427                for (int i = 0; i < stars; i++) {
428                        generateSystem(new Vector2f(0, 0));
429                        if (system != null) {
430                                systems.add(system);
431                        }
432                }
433                
434                
435                SpringSystem springs = ConstellationGen.doConstellationLayout(systems, random, loc);
436                Global.getSector().getHyperspace().updateAllOrbits();
437                
438                HyperspaceTerrainPlugin plugin = (HyperspaceTerrainPlugin) Misc.getHyperspaceTerrain().getPlugin();
439                NebulaEditor editor = new NebulaEditor(plugin);
440                
441                float minRadius = plugin.getTileSize() * 2f;
442                for (StarSystemAPI curr : systems) {
443                        float radius = curr.getMaxRadiusInHyperspace();
444                        editor.clearArc(curr.getLocation().x, curr.getLocation().y, 0, radius + minRadius * 0.5f, 0, 360f);
445                        editor.clearArc(curr.getLocation().x, curr.getLocation().y, 0, radius + minRadius, 0, 360f, 0.25f);
446                }
447                
448                for (SpringConnection conn : springs.connections) {
449                        if (!conn.pull) continue;
450                        float r1 = ((StarSystemAPI)conn.from.custom).getMaxRadiusInHyperspace();
451                        float r2 = ((StarSystemAPI)conn.to.custom).getMaxRadiusInHyperspace();
452                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(conn.from.loc, conn.to.loc);
453                        
454                        float radius = Math.max(0, dist * 0.67f - r1 - r2);
455                        
456//                      float x = (conn.from.loc.x + conn.to.loc.x) * 0.5f;
457//                      float y = (conn.from.loc.y + conn.to.loc.y) * 0.5f;
458//                      editor.clearArc(x, y, 0, radius + minRadius * 0.5f, 0, 360f);
459//                      editor.clearArc(x, y, 0, radius + minRadius, 0, 360f, 0.25f);
460                        
461                        Vector2f diff = Vector2f.sub(conn.to.loc, conn.from.loc, new Vector2f());
462                        float x = conn.from.loc.x + diff.x * 0.33f;
463                        float y = conn.from.loc.y + diff.y * 0.33f;
464                        editor.clearArc(x, y, 0, radius + minRadius * 1f, 0, 360f);
465                        editor.clearArc(x, y, 0, radius + minRadius * 2f, 0, 360f, 0.25f);
466                        
467                        x = conn.from.loc.x + diff.x * 0.67f;
468                        y = conn.from.loc.y + diff.y * 0.67f;
469                        editor.clearArc(x, y, 0, radius + minRadius * 1f, 0, 360f);
470                        editor.clearArc(x, y, 0, radius + minRadius * 2f, 0, 360f, 0.25f);
471                }
472                
473                ConstellationType type = ConstellationType.NORMAL;
474                if (!NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType)) {
475                        type = ConstellationType.NEBULA;
476                }
477                
478                Constellation c = new Constellation(type, constellationAge);
479                //c.setType(ConstellationType.NORMAL); // for now; too many end up being called "Nebula" otherwise
480                c.getSystems().addAll(systems);
481                c.setLagrangeParentMap(lagrangeParentMap);
482                c.setAllEntitiesAdded(allNameableEntitiesAdded);
483
484                
485//              SalvageEntityGeneratorOld seg = new SalvageEntityGeneratorOld(c);
486//              seg.addSalvageableEntities();
487                
488
489                NameAssigner namer = new NameAssigner(c);
490                namer.setSpecialNamesProbability(0.37f);
491                namer.assignNames(params.name, params.secondaryName);
492                
493                for (SectorEntityToken entity : allNameableEntitiesAdded.keySet()) {
494                        if (entity instanceof PlanetAPI && entity.getMarket() != null) {
495                                entity.getMarket().setName(entity.getName());
496                        }
497                }
498                
499                //if (systems.size() > 1) {
500                        for (StarSystemAPI system : systems) {
501                                system.setConstellation(c);
502                        }
503                //}
504                
505                return c;
506        }

509        public void generateSystem(Vector2f loc) {
510                //index++;
511                
512                systemType = pickSystemType(constellationAge);
513                
514//              if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
515//                      System.out.println("wfwefwe1231232");
516//              }
517                
518                String uuid = Misc.genUID();
519                
520//              String id = "system_" + index;
521//              String name = "System " + index;
522                
523                String id = "system_" + uuid;
524                String name = "System " + uuid;
525                
526//              String base = constellationName.nameWithRomanSuffixIfAny;
527//              if (constellationName.secondaryWithRomanSuffixIfAny != null) {
528//                      base = constellationName.secondaryWithRomanSuffixIfAny;
529//              }
530//              String name = Global.getSettings().getNextGreekLetter(constellationName) + " " + base;
531//              String id = name.toLowerCase();
532                
533                
534                //if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) name += " Nebula";
535                
536                if (!initSystem(name, loc)) {
537                        cleanup();
538                        return;
539                }
540                
541                star = null;
542                secondary = null;
543                tertiary = null;
544                systemCenter = null;
545                
546                
547                
548                if (!addStars(id)) {
549                        cleanup();
550                        return;
551                }
552                
553//              if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
554//                      if (star.getSpec().isBlackHole()) {
555//                              System.out.println("wefwefew");
556//                      }
557//              }
558                
559                updateAgeAfterPickingStar();
560                
561                float binaryPad = 1500f;
562                
563                float maxOrbitRadius = MAX_ORBIT_RADIUS;
564                if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_FAR || 
565                                systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR ||
566                                systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2FAR) {
567                        maxOrbitRadius -= FAR_MAX_ORBIT_RADIUS + binaryPad;
568                }
569                GenResult result = addPlanetsAndTerrain(MAX_ORBIT_RADIUS);
570                //addJumpPoints(result);
571                float primaryOrbitalRadius = star.getRadius();
572                if (result != null) {
573                        primaryOrbitalRadius = result.orbitalWidth * 0.5f;
574                }
575                
576                // add far stars, if needed
577                float orbitAngle = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
578                float baseOrbitRadius = primaryOrbitalRadius + binaryPad;
579                float orbitDays = baseOrbitRadius / (3f + random.nextFloat() * 2f);
580                if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_FAR && secondary != null) {
581                        addFarStar(secondary, orbitAngle, baseOrbitRadius, orbitDays);
582                } else if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR && tertiary != null) {
583                        addFarStar(tertiary, orbitAngle, baseOrbitRadius, orbitDays);
584                } else if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2FAR) {
585                        addFarStar(secondary, orbitAngle, baseOrbitRadius, orbitDays);
586                        addFarStar(tertiary, orbitAngle + 60f + 180f * random.nextFloat(), baseOrbitRadius, orbitDays);
587                }
588                
589
590                if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
591                        star.setSkipForJumpPointAutoGen(true);
592                }
593                
594                addJumpPoints(result, false);
595                
596                if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
597                        system.removeEntity(star);
598                        StarCoronaTerrainPlugin coronaPlugin = Misc.getCoronaFor(star);
599                        if (coronaPlugin != null) {
600                                system.removeEntity(coronaPlugin.getEntity());
601                        }
602                        system.setStar(null);
603                        system.initNonStarCenter();
604                        for (SectorEntityToken entity : system.getAllEntities()) {
605                                if (entity.getOrbitFocus() == star ||
606                                        entity.getOrbitFocus() == system.getCenter()) {
607                                        entity.setOrbit(null);
608                                }
609                        }
610                        system.getCenter().addTag(Tags.AMBIENT_LS);
611                }
612                
613                system.autogenerateHyperspaceJumpPoints(true, false);
614                
615                if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
616                        //system.addEntity(star);

628        protected void addFarStar(PlanetAPI farStar, float orbitAngle, float baseOrbitRadius, float orbitPeriod) {
629                float min = 0;
630                float max = 2;
631                int numOrbits = (int) Math.round(getNormalRandom(min, max));
632                GenResult resultFar = null;
633                if (numOrbits > 0) {
634                        float currentRadius = farStar.getRadius() + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * random.nextFloat();
635
636                        StarGenDataSpec farData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, farStar.getSpec().getPlanetType(), false);
637                        StarAge farAge = farData.getAge();
638                        if (farAge == StarAge.ANY) {
639                                farAge = constellationAge;
640                        }
641                        
642                        //GenContext context = new GenContext(this, system, star, starData, 
643                        GenContext context = new GenContext(this, system, farStar, farData, 
644                                                                null, 0, farAge.name(), currentRadius, FAR_MAX_ORBIT_RADIUS, null, -1);
645                        
646                        
647                        resultFar = addOrbitingEntities(context, numOrbits, false, true, false, true);
648                        resultFar.context = context;
649                }
650                
651                if (resultFar != null) {
652                        baseOrbitRadius += resultFar.orbitalWidth * 0.5f;
653                }
654                
655                SectorEntityToken center = star;
656                if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR) {
657                        center = systemCenter;
658                }
659                farStar.setCircularOrbit(center, orbitAngle, baseOrbitRadius, orbitPeriod);
660                
661                if (resultFar != null) {
662                        addJumpPoints(resultFar, true);
663                }
664        }

668        protected StarSystemType pickSystemType(StarAge constellationAge) {
669//              if (true) {
670//                      return StarSystemType.BINARY_CLOSE;
671//              }
672                
673                if (params != null && !params.systemTypes.isEmpty()) {
674                        return params.systemTypes.remove(0);
675                }
676                
677                
678                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemType> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemType>(random);
679                for (StarSystemType type : EnumSet.allOf(StarSystemType.class)) {
680                        if (type == StarSystemType.DEEP_SPACE || type == StarSystemType.DEEP_SPACE_GAS_GIANT) continue;
681                        
682                        Object test = Global.getSettings().getSpec(LocationGenDataSpec.class, type.name(), true);
683                        if (test == null) continue;
684                        LocationGenDataSpec data = (LocationGenDataSpec) test;
685                        
686                        boolean nebulaStatusOk = NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType) || !data.hasTag(TAG_NOT_IN_NEBULA);
687                        nebulaStatusOk &= !NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType) || !data.hasTag(TAG_REQUIRES_NEBULA);
688
689                        if (!nebulaStatusOk) continue;
690                        
691                        float freq = 0f;
692                        switch (constellationAge) {
693                        case AVERAGE:
694                                freq = data.getFreqAVERAGE();
695                                break;
696                        case OLD:
697                                freq = data.getFreqOLD();
698                                break;
699                        case YOUNG:
700                                freq = data.getFreqYOUNG();
701                                break;
702                        }
703                        picker.add(type, freq);
704                }
705                
706                return picker.pick();
707                
708                //return StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR;
709                //return StarSystemType.TRINARY_2FAR;
710                //return StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE;
711                //return StarSystemType.BINARY_CLOSE;
712                //return StarSystemType.BINARY_FAR;
713                //return StarSystemType.NORMAL;
714        }

717        protected boolean addStars(String id) {
718                if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_CLOSE || 
719                                systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR ||
720                                systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE) {
721                        system.initNonStarCenter();
722                        systemCenter = system.getCenter();
723                }
724                
725//              if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
726//                      if (system.getId().equals("system 7f6")) {
727//                              System.out.println("wefwefew");
728//                      }
729//              }
730                
731                PlanetSpecAPI starSpec = pickStar(constellationAge);
732                if (starSpec == null) return false;
733                
734                starData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, starSpec.getPlanetType(), false);
735                float radius = getRadius(starData.getMinRadius(), starData.getMaxRadius());
736                
737                float corona = radius * (starData.getCoronaMult() + starData.getCoronaVar() * (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f));
738                if (corona < starData.getCoronaMin()) corona = starData.getCoronaMin();
739                
740                //corona += 2000f;
741
742                star = system.initStar(id, // unique id for this star 
743                                                                                    starSpec.getPlanetType(),  // id in planets.json
744                                                                                    radius,               // radius (in pixels at default zoom)
745                                                                                    corona,  // corona radius, from star edge 
746                                                                                    starData.getSolarWind(),
747                                                                                    (float) (starData.getMinFlare() + (starData.getMaxFlare() - starData.getMinFlare()) * random.nextFloat()),
748                                                                                    starData.getCrLossMult()
749                                                                                        );
750                
751                if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
752                        star.addTag(Tags.AMBIENT_LS);
753                }
754                
755                if (systemCenter == null) {
756                        systemCenter = star;
757                        centerRadius = star.getRadius();
758                }
759                
760                
761                // create and switch aronud stars so that the primary is always the largest
762                if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_CLOSE) {
763                        secondary = addRandomStar(id + "_b", system.getBaseName() + " B");
764                        if (secondary == null) return false;
765                        switchPrimaryAndSecondaryIfNeeded(true);
766                } else if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_FAR) {
767                        secondary = addRandomStar(id + "_b", system.getBaseName() + " B");
768                        if (secondary == null) return false;
769                        switchPrimaryAndSecondaryIfNeeded(true);
770                        
771                        centerRadius = star.getRadius();
772                        
773                        secondary.setLightColorOverrideIfStar(pickLightColorForStar(secondary));
774                } else if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE ||
775                                   systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR ||
776                                   systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2FAR) {
777                        secondary = addRandomStar(id + "_b", system.getBaseName() + " B");
778                        if (secondary == null) return false;
779                        switchPrimaryAndSecondaryIfNeeded(true);
780                        
781                        tertiary = addRandomStar(id + "_c", system.getBaseName() + " C");
782                        if (tertiary == null) return false;
783                        switchPrimaryAndTertiaryIfNeeded(true);
784                        
785                        if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR) {
786                                tertiary.setLightColorOverrideIfStar(pickLightColorForStar(tertiary));
787                        } else if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2FAR) {
788                                secondary.setLightColorOverrideIfStar(pickLightColorForStar(secondary));
789                                tertiary.setLightColorOverrideIfStar(pickLightColorForStar(tertiary));
790                        }
791                }
792                
793                // make close stars orbit common center
794                if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_CLOSE || systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR) {
795                        float dist = STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * random.nextFloat();
796                        
797                        float r1 = star.getRadius();
798                        float r2 = secondary.getRadius();
799                        if (star.getSpec().getPlanetType().equals("black_hole")) r1 *= 5f;
800                        if (secondary.getSpec().getPlanetType().equals("black_hole")) r2 *= 5f;
801                        
802                        float totalRadius = r1 + r2;
803                        dist += totalRadius;
804                        
805                        float orbitPrimary = dist * r2 / totalRadius;
806                        float orbitSecondary = dist * r1 / totalRadius;
807                        
808                        centerRadius = Math.max(orbitPrimary + star.getRadius(), orbitSecondary + secondary.getRadius()); 
809                        
810                        float anglePrimary = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
811                        float orbitDays = dist / (30f + random.nextFloat() * 50f); 
812                        
813                        star.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), anglePrimary, orbitPrimary, orbitDays);
814                        secondary.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), anglePrimary + 180f, orbitSecondary, orbitDays);
815                        
816//                      if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR && tertiary != null) {
817//                              tertiary.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), 
818//                                              tertiary.getCircularOrbitAngle(),
819//                                              tertiary.getCircularOrbitRadius(),
820//                                              tertiary.getCircularOrbitPeriod());
821//                      }
822                } else if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE) {
823                        float dist = STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * random.nextFloat();
824                        dist += star.getRadius();
825                        
826                        float anglePrimary = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
827                        float orbitDays = dist / (20f + random.nextFloat() * 80f);
828                        
829                        // smaller dist for primary/secondary so that their gravity wells get generated first
830                        // and are closer to the center
831                        star.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), anglePrimary, dist - 10, orbitDays);
832                        secondary.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), anglePrimary + 120f, dist - 5, orbitDays);
833                        tertiary.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), anglePrimary + 240f, dist, orbitDays);
834                        
835                        centerRadius = dist + star.getRadius();
836                } else {
837                        star.getLocation().set(0, 0);
838                }
839                
840
841                if (star != null) {
842                        starData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, star.getSpec().getPlanetType(), false);
843                }
844//              if (systemCenter instanceof PlanetAPI) {
845//                      centerRadius = star.getRadius();
846//              }
847                
848
849                setDefaultLightColorBasedOnStars();
850                
851                
852                if (star != null) {
853                        ArrayList<SectorEntityToken> list = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>();
854                        list.add(star);
855                        allNameableEntitiesAdded.put(star, list);
856                        system.setStar(star);
857                }
858                if (secondary != null) {
859                        ArrayList<SectorEntityToken> list = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>();
860                        list.add(secondary);
861                        allNameableEntitiesAdded.put(secondary, list);
862                        system.setSecondary(secondary);
863                }
864                if (tertiary != null){
865                        ArrayList<SectorEntityToken> list = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>();
866                        list.add(tertiary);
867                        allNameableEntitiesAdded.put(tertiary, list);
868                        system.setTertiary(tertiary);
869                }
870                
871                setBlackHoleIfBlackHole(star);
872                setBlackHoleIfBlackHole(secondary);
873                setBlackHoleIfBlackHole(tertiary);
874                
875                setPulsarIfNeutron(star);
876                setPulsarIfNeutron(secondary);
877                setPulsarIfNeutron(tertiary);
878                
879                return true;
880        }

882        protected void setBlackHoleIfBlackHole(PlanetAPI star) {
883                if (star == null) return;
884                
885                if (star.getSpec().getPlanetType().equals("black_hole")) {
886                        StarCoronaTerrainPlugin coronaPlugin = Misc.getCoronaFor(star);
887                        if (coronaPlugin != null) {
888                                system.removeEntity(coronaPlugin.getEntity());
889                        }
890                        
891                        StarGenDataSpec starData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, star.getSpec().getPlanetType(), false);
892                        float corona = star.getRadius() * (starData.getCoronaMult() + starData.getCoronaVar() * (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f));
893                        if (corona < starData.getCoronaMin()) corona = starData.getCoronaMin();
894                        
895                        SectorEntityToken eventHorizon = system.addTerrain(Terrain.EVENT_HORIZON, 
896                                        new CoronaParams(star.getRadius() + corona, (star.getRadius() + corona) / 2f,
897                                                                        star, starData.getSolarWind(), 
898                                                                        (float) (starData.getMinFlare() + (starData.getMaxFlare() - starData.getMinFlare()) * random.nextFloat()),
899                                                                        starData.getCrLossMult()));
900                        eventHorizon.setCircularOrbit(star, 0, 0, 100);
901                }
902        }

933        protected void switchPrimaryAndSecondaryIfNeeded(boolean sizeDownSmaller) {
934                if (star == null || secondary == null) return;
935                
936                if (star.getRadius() < secondary.getRadius()) {
937                        star = secondary;
938                        secondary = system.getStar();
939                        system.setStar(star);
940                        
941                        String temp = star.getName();
942                        star.setName(secondary.getName());
943                        secondary.setName(temp);
944                        
945                        temp = star.getId();
946                        star.setId(secondary.getId());
947                        secondary.setId(temp);
948                        
949                        if (sizeDownSmaller) {
950                                secondary.setRadius(Math.min(secondary.getRadius(), star.getRadius() * 0.67f));
951                        }
952                        
953                        if (secondary == systemCenter) {
954                                systemCenter = star;
955                                centerRadius = systemCenter.getRadius();
956                        }
957                }
958        }
959        
960        protected void switchPrimaryAndTertiaryIfNeeded(boolean sizeDownSmaller) {
961                if (star == null || tertiary == null) return;
962                
963                if (star.getRadius() < tertiary.getRadius()) {
964                        star = tertiary;
965                        tertiary = system.getStar();
966                        system.setStar(star);
967                        
968                        String temp = star.getName();
969                        star.setName(tertiary.getName());
970                        tertiary.setName(temp);
971                        
972                        temp = star.getId();
973                        star.setId(tertiary.getId());
974                        tertiary.setId(temp);
975                        
976                        if (sizeDownSmaller) {
977                                tertiary.setRadius(Math.min(tertiary.getRadius(), star.getRadius() * 0.67f));
978                        }
979                        
980                        if (tertiary == systemCenter) {
981                                systemCenter = star;
982                                centerRadius = systemCenter.getRadius();
983                        }
984                }
985        }

990                int min = 1;
991                int max = 3;
992                
993//              int planets = system.getPlanets().size(); // includes stars
994//              max = Math.min(max, planets/2);

1006        public static List<AddedEntity> addStableLocations(StarSystemAPI system, int num) {
1007                List<AddedEntity> result = new ArrayList<>();
1008                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
1009                        LinkedHashMap<LocationType, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<LocationType, Float>();
1010                        weights.put(LocationType.STAR_ORBIT, 10f);
1011                        weights.put(LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM, 10f);
1012                        weights.put(LocationType.L_POINT, 10f);
1013                        weights.put(LocationType.IN_SMALL_NEBULA, 2f);
1014                        WeightedRandomPicker<EntityLocation> locs = BaseThemeGenerator.getLocations(random, system, null, 100f, weights);
1015                        EntityLocation loc = locs.pick();
1016                        
1017                        AddedEntity added = BaseThemeGenerator.addNonSalvageEntity(system, loc, Entities.STABLE_LOCATION, Factions.NEUTRAL);
1018                        //if (DEBUG && added != null) System.out.println("    Added stable location");
1019                        
1020                        if (added != null) {
1021                                result.add(added);
1022                                BaseThemeGenerator.convertOrbitPointingDown(added.entity);
1023                        }
1024                }
1025                return result;
1026        }

1029        protected void addJumpPoints(GenResult result, boolean farStarMode) {
1030                
1031                //float outerRadius = star.getRadius() + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * random.nextFloat();
1032                float outerRadius = centerRadius + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * random.nextFloat();
1033                if (result != null) {
1034                        outerRadius = result.orbitalWidth / 2f + 500f;
1035                }
1036                
1037                if (farStarMode) {
1038                        //if (result.context.orbitIndex < 0) {
1039                        if (result.context.orbitIndex < 0 && random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
1040                                return;
1041                        }
1042                        SectorEntityToken farStar = result.context.center;
1043                        String name = "Omega Jump-point";
1044                        if (result.context.center == tertiary) {
1045                                name = "Omicron Jump-point";
1046                        }
1047                        JumpPointAPI point = Global.getFactory().createJumpPoint(null, name);
1048                        point.setStandardWormholeToHyperspaceVisual();
1049                        float orbitDays = outerRadius / (15f + random.nextFloat() * 5f);
1050                        //point.setCircularOrbit(star, random.nextFloat() * 360f, outerRadius, orbitDays);
1051                        point.setCircularOrbit(farStar, random.nextFloat() * 360f, outerRadius, orbitDays);
1052                        system.addEntity(point);
1053                        
1054                        return;
1055                }
1056                
1057                
1058                //JumpPointAPI point = Global.getFactory().createJumpPoint(null, system.getBaseName() + " Fringe");
1059                JumpPointAPI point = Global.getFactory().createJumpPoint(null, "Fringe Jump-point");
1060                point.setStandardWormholeToHyperspaceVisual();
1061                float orbitDays = outerRadius / (15f + random.nextFloat() * 5f);
1062                //point.setCircularOrbit(star, random.nextFloat() * 360f, outerRadius, orbitDays);
1063                point.setCircularOrbit(systemCenter, random.nextFloat() * 360f, outerRadius, orbitDays);
1064                system.addEntity(point);
1065
1066                
1067                // to make sure that "is this location clear" calculations below always work
1068                system.updateAllOrbits();
1069                
1070                
1071                if (result != null) {
1072                        float halfway = outerRadius * 0.5f;
1073                        
1074                        WeightedRandomPicker<LagrangePoint> inner = new WeightedRandomPicker<LagrangePoint>(random);
1075                        WeightedRandomPicker<LagrangePoint> outer = new WeightedRandomPicker<LagrangePoint>(random);
1076                        
1077                        int total = 0;
1078                        for (GeneratedPlanet planet : result.context.generatedPlanets) {
1079                                if (planet.isMoon) continue;
1080                                if (planet.planet.getOrbit() == null || planet.planet.getOrbit().getFocus() == null) continue;
1081                                total++;
1082                                
1083                                for (LagrangePointType type : EnumSet.of(LagrangePointType.L4, LagrangePointType.L5)) {
1084                                        float orbitRadius = planet.orbitRadius;
1085                                        float angleOffset = -LAGRANGE_OFFSET * 0.5f;
1086                                        if (type == LagrangePointType.L5) angleOffset = LAGRANGE_OFFSET * 0.5f;
1087                                        float angle = planet.orbitAngle + angleOffset;
1088                                        Vector2f location = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + angleOffset);
1089                                        location.scale(orbitRadius);
1090                                        Vector2f.add(location, planet.planet.getOrbit().getFocus().getLocation(), location);
1091                                        
1092                                        boolean clear = true;
1093                                        for (PlanetAPI curr : system.getPlanets()) {
1094                                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(curr.getLocation(), location);
1095                                                //System.out.println(type.name() + ": " + location + ", " + "Dist: " + dist + " (to " + curr.getName() + " at " + curr.getLocation() + ")");
1096                                                if (dist < 500) {
1097                                                        clear = false;
1098                                                        break;
1099                                                }
1100                                        }
1101                                        if (clear) {
1102                                                if (planet.orbitRadius < halfway || planet.orbitRadius < 5000f) {
1103                                                        inner.add(new LagrangePoint(planet, type), 10f);
1104                                                } else {
1105                                                        outer.add(new LagrangePoint(planet, type), 10f);
1106                                                }
1107                                        }
1108                                }
1109                        }
1110                        
1111                        
1112                        if (outerRadius > 2000f + 5000f * random.nextFloat()) {
1113                                boolean addedOne = false;
1114                                if (!inner.isEmpty()) {
1115                                        LagrangePoint p = inner.pick();
1116                                        //addJumpPoint(p, p.parent.planet.getName() + " Jump-point");
1117                                        String name = "Inner System Jump-point";
1118                                        if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) name = "Inner Jump-point";
1119                                        addJumpPoint(p, name);
1120                                        addedOne = true;
1121                                }
1122                                
1123                                
1124                                if (!outer.isEmpty() && (random.nextFloat() < outer.getItems().size() * 0.2f || !addedOne)) {
1125                                        LagrangePoint p = outer.pick();
1126                                        String name = "Outer System Jump-point";
1127                                        if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) name = "Outer Jump-point";
1128                                        addJumpPoint(p, name);
1129                                        //addJumpPoint(p, "Outer System Jump-point");
1130                                        addedOne = true;
1131                                }
1132                                
1133//                              while (!inner.isEmpty()) {
1134//                                      LagrangePoint p = inner.pickAndRemove();
1135//                                      //addJumpPoint(p, p.parent.planet.getName() + " Jump-point");
1136//                                      addJumpPoint(p, system.getBaseName() + " Inner System Jump-point");
1137//                              }
1138//                              while (!outer.isEmpty()) {
1139//                                      LagrangePoint p = outer.pickAndRemove();
1140//                                      //addJumpPoint(p, p.parent.planet.getName() + " Jump-point");
1141//                                      addJumpPoint(p, system.getBaseName() + " Outer System Jump-point");
1142//                              }
1143                        }
1144                }
1145                
1146                //system.autogenerateHyperspaceJumpPoints(true, false);
1147        }

1149        protected void addJumpPoint(LagrangePoint p, String name) {
1150                float orbitRadius = p.parent.orbitRadius;
1151                float orbitDays = p.parent.orbitDays;
1152                float angleOffset = -LAGRANGE_OFFSET * 0.5f;
1153                if (p.type == LagrangePointType.L5) angleOffset = LAGRANGE_OFFSET * 0.5f;
1154                float angle = p.parent.orbitAngle + angleOffset;
1155
1156                SectorEntityToken focus = p.parent.planet.getOrbitFocus();
1157                if (focus == null) focus = systemCenter;
1158                
1159                JumpPointAPI point = Global.getFactory().createJumpPoint(null, name);
1160                point.setStandardWormholeToHyperspaceVisual();
1161                if (!p.parent.planet.isGasGiant()) {
1162                        point.setRelatedPlanet(p.parent.planet);
1163                }
1164                //point.setCircularOrbit(star, angle + angleOffset, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
1165                //point.setCircularOrbit(systemCenter, angle + angleOffset, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
1166                point.setCircularOrbit(focus, angle + angleOffset, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
1167                system.addEntity(point);
1168        }

1176        public static float addOrbitingEntities(StarSystemAPI system, SectorEntityToken parentStar, StarAge age,
1177                                                                                   int min, int max, float startingRadius,
1178                                                                                   int nameOffset, boolean withSpecialNames,
1179                                                                                   boolean allowHabitable) {
1180                CustomConstellationParams p = new CustomConstellationParams(age);
1181                p.forceNebula = true; // not sure why this is here; should avoid small nebula at lagrange points though (but is that desired?)
1182                
1183                StarSystemGenerator gen = new StarSystemGenerator(p);
1184                gen.system = system;
1185                gen.starData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, system.getStar().getSpec().getPlanetType(), false);
1186                gen.starAge = age;
1187                gen.constellationAge = age;
1188                gen.starAgeData = (AgeGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(AgeGenDataSpec.class, age.name(), true);
1189                gen.star = system.getStar();
1190                
1191                gen.pickNebulaAndBackground();
1192                if (system.getType() != null) gen.systemType = system.getType();
1193                
1194                
1195                gen.systemCenter = system.getCenter();
1196                
1197                StarGenDataSpec starData = gen.starData;
1198                PlanetGenDataSpec planetData = null;
1199                PlanetAPI parentPlanet = null;
1200                if (parentStar instanceof PlanetAPI) {
1201                        PlanetAPI planet = (PlanetAPI) parentStar;
1202                        if (planet.isStar()) {
1203                                starData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, planet.getSpec().getPlanetType(), false);
1204                        } else {
1205                                planetData = (PlanetGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(PlanetGenDataSpec.class, planet.getSpec().getPlanetType(), false);
1206                                parentPlanet = planet;
1207                        }
1208                }
1209                
1210                int parentOrbitIndex = -1;
1211                int startingOrbitIndex = 0;
1212                
1213                boolean addingAroundStar = parentPlanet == null;
1214                float r = 0;
1215                if (parentStar != null) {
1216                        r = parentStar.getRadius();
1217                }
1218
1219                float approximateExtraRadiusPerOrbit = 400f;
1220                if (addingAroundStar) {
1221                        parentOrbitIndex = -1;
1222                        startingOrbitIndex = (int) ((startingRadius  - r - STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE - STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * 0.5f) /
1223                                                             (BASE_INCR * 1.25f + approximateExtraRadiusPerOrbit));
1224                        
1225                        if (startingOrbitIndex < 0) startingOrbitIndex = 0;
1226                } else {
1227                        float dist = 0f;
1228                        if (parentPlanet.getOrbitFocus() != null) {
1229                                dist = Misc.getDistance(parentPlanet.getLocation(), parentPlanet.getOrbitFocus().getLocation());
1230                        }
1231                        parentOrbitIndex = (int) ((dist - r - STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE - STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * 0.5f) /
1232                                                           (BASE_INCR * 1.25f + approximateExtraRadiusPerOrbit));
1233                        startingOrbitIndex = (int) ((startingRadius - STARTING_RADIUS_MOON_BASE - STARTING_RADIUS_MOON_RANGE * 0.5f) /
1234                                                           (BASE_INCR_MOON * 1.25f));
1235                        
1236                        if (parentOrbitIndex < 0) parentOrbitIndex = 0;
1237                        if (startingOrbitIndex < 0) startingOrbitIndex = 0;
1238                }
1239                
1240                int num = (int) Math.round(getNormalRandom(min, max));
1241                
1242                GenContext context = new GenContext(gen, system, gen.systemCenter, starData, 
1243                                                        parentPlanet, startingOrbitIndex, age.name(), startingRadius, MAX_ORBIT_RADIUS,
1244                                                        planetData != null ? planetData.getCategory() : null, parentOrbitIndex);
1245                
1246                if (!allowHabitable) {
1247                        context.excludeCategories.add(CAT_HAB5);
1248                        context.excludeCategories.add(CAT_HAB4);
1249                        context.excludeCategories.add(CAT_HAB3);
1250                        context.excludeCategories.add(CAT_HAB2);
1251                }
1252                
1253                GenResult result = gen.addOrbitingEntities(context, num, false, addingAroundStar, false, false);
1254                
1255                
1256                Constellation c = new Constellation(ConstellationType.NORMAL, age);
1257                c.getSystems().add(system);
1258                c.setLagrangeParentMap(gen.lagrangeParentMap);
1259                c.setAllEntitiesAdded(gen.allNameableEntitiesAdded);
1260                c.setLeavePickedNameUnused(true);
1261                NameAssigner namer = new NameAssigner(c);
1262                if (withSpecialNames) {
1263                        namer.setSpecialNamesProbability(1f);
1264                } else {
1265                        namer.setSpecialNamesProbability(0f);
1266                }
1267                namer.setRenameSystem(false);
1268                namer.setStructuralNameOffset(nameOffset);
1269                namer.assignNames(null, null);
1270                
1271                for (SectorEntityToken entity : gen.allNameableEntitiesAdded.keySet()) {
1272                        if (entity instanceof PlanetAPI && entity.getMarket() != null) {
1273                                entity.getMarket().setName(entity.getName());
1274                        }
1275                }
1276                
1277                return result.orbitalWidth * 0.5f;
1278                
1279        }

1301        protected void addSystemwideNebula() {
1302                if (nebulaType.equals(NEBULA_NONE)) return;
1303                
1304                
1305                int w = 128;
1306                int h = 128;
1307                
1308                StringBuilder string = new StringBuilder();
1309                for (int y = h - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
1310                        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
1311                                string.append("x");
1312                        }
1313                }
1314                SectorEntityToken nebula = system.addTerrain(Terrain.NEBULA, new TileParams(string.toString(),
1315                                                        w, h,
1316                                                        "terrain", nebulaType, 4, 4, null));
1317                nebula.getLocation().set(0, 0);
1318                
1319                NebulaTerrainPlugin nebulaPlugin = (NebulaTerrainPlugin)((CampaignTerrainAPI)nebula).getPlugin();
1320                NebulaEditor editor = new NebulaEditor(nebulaPlugin);
1321                
1322                editor.regenNoise();
1323                
1324                // good medium thickness: 0.6
1325                //editor.noisePrune(0.8f);
1326                
1327                // yes, star age here, despite using constellation age to determine if a nebula to all exists
1328                // basically: young star in old constellation will have lots of nebula, but of the constellation-age color
1329                editor.noisePrune(starAgeData.getNebulaDensity());
1330                //editor.noisePrune(0.75f);
1331                //editor.noisePrune(0.1f);
1332                
1333//              for (float f = 0.1f; f <= 0.9f; f += 0.05f) {
1334//                      editor.noisePrune(f);
1335//              }
1336                
1337                editor.regenNoise();
1338                
1339                if (systemType != StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
1340                        for (PlanetAPI planet : system.getPlanets()) {
1341                                
1342                                if (planet.getOrbit() != null && planet.getOrbit().getFocus() != null &&
1343                                                planet.getOrbit().getFocus().getOrbit() != null) {
1344                                        // this planet is orbiting something that's orbiting something
1345                                        // its motion will be relative to its parent moving
1346                                        // don't clear anything out for this planet
1347                                        continue;
1348                                }
1349                                
1350                                float clearThreshold = 0f; // clear everything by default
1351                                float clearInnerRadius = 0f;
1352                                float clearOuterRadius = 0f;
1353                                Vector2f clearLoc = null;
1354        
1355                                
1356                                if (!planet.isStar() && !planet.isGasGiant()) {
1357                                        clearThreshold = 1f - Math.min(0f, planet.getRadius() / 300f);
1358                                        if (clearThreshold > 0.5f) clearThreshold = 0.5f;
1359                                }
1360                                
1361                                Vector2f loc = planet.getLocation();
1362                                if (planet.getOrbit() != null && planet.getOrbit().getFocus() != null) {
1363                                        Vector2f focusLoc = planet.getOrbit().getFocus().getLocation();
1364                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(planet.getOrbit().getFocus().getLocation(), loc);
1365                                        float width = planet.getRadius() * 4f + 100f;
1366                                        if (planet.isStar()) {
1367                                                StarCoronaTerrainPlugin corona = Misc.getCoronaFor(planet);
1368                                                if (corona != null) {
1369                                                        width = corona.getParams().bandWidthInEngine * 4f;
1370                                                }
1371                                                PulsarBeamTerrainPlugin pulsar = Misc.getPulsarFor(planet);
1372                                                if (pulsar != null) {
1373                                                        width = Math.max(width, pulsar.getParams().bandWidthInEngine * 0.5f);
1374                                                }
1375                                        }
1376                                        clearLoc = focusLoc;
1377                                        clearInnerRadius = dist - width / 2f;
1378                                        clearOuterRadius = dist + width / 2f;
1379                                } else if (planet.getOrbit() == null) {
1380                                        float width = planet.getRadius() * 4f + 100f;
1381                                        if (planet.isStar()) {
1382                                                StarCoronaTerrainPlugin corona = Misc.getCoronaFor(planet);
1383                                                if (corona != null) {
1384                                                        width = corona.getParams().bandWidthInEngine * 4f;
1385                                                }
1386                                                PulsarBeamTerrainPlugin pulsar = Misc.getPulsarFor(planet);
1387                                                if (pulsar != null) {
1388                                                        width = Math.max(width, pulsar.getParams().bandWidthInEngine * 0.5f);
1389                                                }
1390                                        }
1391                                        clearLoc = loc;
1392                                        clearInnerRadius = 0f;
1393                                        clearOuterRadius = width;
1394                                }
1395                                
1396                                if (clearLoc != null) {
1397                                        float min = nebulaPlugin.getTileSize() * 2f;
1398                                        if (clearOuterRadius - clearInnerRadius < min) {
1399                                                clearOuterRadius = clearInnerRadius + min;
1400                                        }
1401                                        editor.clearArc(clearLoc.x, clearLoc.y, clearInnerRadius, clearOuterRadius, 0, 360f, clearThreshold);
1402                                }
1403                        }
1404                }
1405
1406                // add a spiral going from the outside towards the star
1407                float angleOffset = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
1408                editor.clearArc(0f, 0f, 30000, 31000 + 1000f * random.nextFloat(), 
1409                                angleOffset + 0f, angleOffset + 360f * (2f + random.nextFloat() * 2f), 0.01f, 0f);
1410                
1411                // do some random arcs
1412                int numArcs = (int) (8f + 6f * random.nextFloat());
1413                //int numArcs = 11;
1414                
1415                for (int i = 0; i < numArcs; i++) {
1416                        //float dist = 4000f + 10000f * random.nextFloat();
1417                        float dist = 15000f + 15000f * random.nextFloat();
1418                        float angle = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
1419                        
1420                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
1421                        dir.scale(dist - (2000f + 8000f * random.nextFloat()));
1422                        
1423                        //float tileSize = nebulaPlugin.getTileSize();
1424                        //float width = tileSize * (2f + 4f * random.nextFloat());
1425                        float width = 800f * (1f + 2f * random.nextFloat());
1426                        
1427                        float clearThreshold = 0f + 0.5f * random.nextFloat();
1428                        //clearThreshold = 0f;
1429                        
1430                        editor.clearArc(dir.x, dir.y, dist - width/2f, dist + width/2f, 0, 360f, clearThreshold);
1431                }
1432        }

1435        protected GenResult addPlanetsAndTerrain(float maxOrbitRadius) {
1436                boolean hasOrbits = random.nextFloat() < starData.getProbOrbits();
1437                if (!hasOrbits) return null;
1438                
1439                float min = starData.getMinOrbits() + starAgeData.getMinExtraOrbits();
1440                float max = starData.getMaxOrbits() + starAgeData.getMaxExtraOrbits();
1441                int numOrbits = (int) Math.round(getNormalRandom(min, max));
1442                
1443                if (numOrbits <= 0) return null;
1444
1445                
1446                
1447                float currentRadius = centerRadius + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE + STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * random.nextFloat();
1448
1449                //GenContext context = new GenContext(this, system, star, starData, 
1450                GenContext context = new GenContext(this, system, systemCenter, starData, 
1451                                                        null, 0, starAge.name(), currentRadius, maxOrbitRadius, null, -1);
1452                
1453                if (systemType == StarSystemType.BINARY_CLOSE || systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR) {
1454                        context.multipliers.add(COL_BINARY);
1455                }
1456                if (systemType == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE) {
1457                        context.multipliers.add(COL_TRINARY);
1458                }
1459                
1460                
1461                GenResult result = addOrbitingEntities(context, numOrbits, false, true, false, true);
1462                result.context = context;

1466        protected GenResult addOrbitingEntities(GenContext context, int numOrbits, boolean addingMoons, boolean addMoons, boolean parentIsMoon, boolean nothingOk) {
1467                
1468                if (DEBUG && context.starData != null) {
1469                        if (addingMoons && context.parent != null) {
1470                                System.out.println("  Adding " + numOrbits + " moon orbits around " + context.parent.getSpec().getPlanetType());
1471                        } else {
1472                                System.out.println("Adding " + numOrbits + " orbits around " + context.starData.getId());
1473                        }
1474                }
1475                
1476                float currentRadius = context.currentRadius;
1477                float lastIncrementExtra = 0f;
1478                
1479                String extraMult = null;
1480                if (parentIsMoon) extraMult = COL_IS_MOON;
1481
1482                int extra = 0;
1483                for (int i = 0; i < numOrbits; i++) {
1484                        
1485                        context.orbitIndex = i + context.startingOrbitIndex + extra;
1486                        //CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData = pickCategory(orbitIndex, i, starAge.name(), starType, context.parentCategory, null, nothingOk);
1487                        CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData = pickCategory(context, extraMult, nothingOk);
1488                        nothingOk = true; // only applies to first pick, after this, we'll have *something*
1489
1490//                      if (!addingMoons) {
1491//                              categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_giant", true);
1492//                              //categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_terrain_rings", true);
1493//                      }
1494//                      if (orbitIndex == 0 && addMoons) {
1495//                              categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_giant", true);
1496//                              //categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_hab4", true);
1497//                      }
1498//                      if (orbitIndex == 1 && addMoons) {
1499//                      if (!addingMoons) {
1500//                              categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_giant", true);
1501//                      }
1502//                      } else {
1503//                              categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_terrain_rings", true);
1504//                      }
1505                        //categoryData = (CategoryGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(CategoryGenDataSpec.class, "cat_terrain_rings", true);
1506                        
1507                        GenResult result = null;
1508                        float incrMult = 1f;
1509
1510                        if (categoryData != null && !CAT_NOTHING.equals(categoryData.getCategory())) {
1511                                //WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> picker = getPickerForCategory(categoryData, orbitIndex, i, starAge.name(), starType, context.parentCategory, null);
1512                                WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> picker = getPickerForCategory(categoryData, context, extraMult);
1513                                if (DEBUG) {
1514                                        picker.print("  Picking from category " + categoryData.getCategory() + 
1515                                                        ", orbit index " + (context.parent != null ? context.parentOrbitIndex : context.orbitIndex));
1516                                }
1517                                EntityGenDataSpec entityData = picker.pick();
1518                                if (DEBUG) {
1519                                        if (entityData == null) {
1520                                                System.out.println("  Nothing to pick");
1521                                                System.out.println();
1522                                        } else {
1523                                                System.out.println("  Picked: " + entityData.getId());
1524                                                System.out.println();
1525                                        }
1526                                }
1527                                
1528                                context.currentRadius = currentRadius;
1529                                //context.orbitIndex = i;
1530                                
1531                                if (entityData instanceof PlanetGenDataSpec) {
1532                                        PlanetGenDataSpec planetData = (PlanetGenDataSpec) entityData;
1533                                        result = addPlanet(context, planetData, addingMoons, addMoons);
1534
1535                                } else if (entityData instanceof TerrainGenDataSpec) {
1536                                        TerrainGenDataSpec terrainData = (TerrainGenDataSpec) entityData;
1537                                        result = addTerrain(context, terrainData);
1538                                }
1539                                
1540                                if (result != null) {
1541                                        //List<SectorEntityToken> combined = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>(result.entities);
1542                                        for (SectorEntityToken curr : result.entities) {
1543                                                if (context.lagrangeParent != null && !result.entities.isEmpty()) {
1544                                                        lagrangeParentMap.put(curr, context.lagrangeParent.planet);
1545                                                }
1546                                                allNameableEntitiesAdded.put(curr, result.entities);
1547                                        }
1548                                } else {
1549                                        incrMult = 0.5f;
1550                                }
1551                        } else {
1552                                incrMult = 0.5f;
1553                        }
1554                        
1555                        float baseIncr = BASE_INCR;
1556                        if (addingMoons) {
1557                                baseIncr = BASE_INCR_MOON;
1558                        }
1559                        baseIncr *= incrMult;
1560                        
1561                        float increment = baseIncr + baseIncr * 0.5f * random.nextFloat();
1562                        if (result != null) {
1563                                if (result.orbitalWidth > 1000) extra++;
1564                                //increment = Math.max(increment, result.orbitalWidth + baseIncr * 0.5f);
1565                                //increment += result.orbitalWidth;
1566                                increment = Math.max(increment + Math.min(result.orbitalWidth, 300f),
1567                                                                         result.orbitalWidth + increment * 0.5f);
1568                                if (result.onlyIncrementByWidth) {
1569                                        increment = result.orbitalWidth;
1570                                }
1571                                lastIncrementExtra = Math.max(increment * 0.1f, increment - result.orbitalWidth);
1572                        } else {
1573                                lastIncrementExtra = increment;
1574                        }
1575                        currentRadius += increment;
1576                        
1577                        if (currentRadius >= context.maxOrbitRadius) {
1578                                break;
1579                        }
1580                }
1581                
1582                GenResult result = new GenResult();
1583                result.onlyIncrementByWidth = false;
1584                result.orbitalWidth = (currentRadius - lastIncrementExtra) * 2f;
1585                return result;
1586        }

1598        public GenResult addPlanet(GenContext context, PlanetGenDataSpec planetData, boolean isMoon, boolean addMoons) {
1599                //float orbitRadius = (orbitIndex + 1f) * 1500 + star.getRadius(); 
1600                float radius = getRadius(planetData.getMinRadius(), planetData.getMaxRadius());
1601                if (isMoon) {// || context.lagrangeParent != null) {
1602                        //radius *= MOON_RADIUS_MULT;
1603                        float mult = MOON_RADIUS_MIN_FRACTION_OF_NORMAL + 
1604                        random.nextFloat() * (MOON_RADIUS_MAX_FRACTION_OF_NORMAL - MOON_RADIUS_MIN_FRACTION_OF_NORMAL);
1605                        radius *= mult;
1606                        if (radius < MIN_MOON_RADIUS) {
1607                                radius = MIN_MOON_RADIUS;
1608                        }
1609                        float parentRadius = 100000f;
1610                        if (context.parent != null || context.lagrangeParent != null) {
1611                                PlanetAPI parent = context.parent;
1612                                if (context.lagrangeParent != null) {
1613                                        parent = context.lagrangeParent.planet;
1614                                }
1615                                parentRadius = parent.getRadius();
1616                        }
1617                        if (context.parentRadiusOverride > 0) {
1618                                parentRadius = context.parentRadiusOverride;
1619                        }
1620                        
1621                        if (parentRadius > MIN_MOON_RADIUS / MOON_RADIUS_MAX_FRACTION_OF_PARENT) {
1622                                float max = parentRadius * MOON_RADIUS_MAX_FRACTION_OF_PARENT;
1623                                if (radius > max) {
1624                                        radius = max;
1625                                }
1626                        }
1627                }
1628                
1629                float orbitRadius = context.currentRadius + radius;
1630                float orbitDays = orbitRadius / (20f + random.nextFloat() * 5f);
1631                
1632                //String planetId = system.getId() + "_planet_" + context.center.getId() + "_" + context.orbitIndex;
1633                String planetId = context.center.getId() + ":planet_" + context.orbitIndex;
1634                String planetName = "Planet " + context.orbitIndex;
1635                if (context.parent != null) {
1636                        planetId = system.getId() + "_moon_" + context.center.getId() + "_" + context.parent.getId() + "_" + context.orbitIndex;
1637                        planetName = context.parent.getName() + " moon " + context.orbitIndex;
1638                }
1639                String planetType = planetData.getId();
1640                SectorEntityToken parent = context.center;
1641                if (context.parent != null) parent = context.parent;
1642                
1643                float angle = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
1644                
1645                // if adding a moon to a largange point planet, then parentCategory == null
1646                // will fail and it'll orbit the parent rather than stay at the point
1647                if (context.parentCategory == null) {
1648                        if (context.lagrangeParent != null && context.lagrangePointType != null) {
1649                                orbitRadius = context.lagrangeParent.orbitRadius;
1650                                orbitDays = context.lagrangeParent.orbitDays;
1651                                float angleOffset = -LAGRANGE_OFFSET;
1652                                if (context.lagrangePointType == LagrangePointType.L5) angleOffset = LAGRANGE_OFFSET;
1653                                angle = context.lagrangeParent.orbitAngle + angleOffset;
1654                                planetName += " " + context.lagrangePointType.name();
1655                                planetId += "_" + context.lagrangePointType.name();
1656                        }
1657                }
1658                
1659                PlanetAPI planet = system.addPlanet(planetId, parent, planetName, planetType, angle, radius, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
1660                if (planet.isGasGiant()) {
1661                        if (systemType == StarSystemType.NEBULA) {
1662                                planet.setAutogenJumpPointNameInHyper(system.getBaseName() + ", " + planetName + " Gravity Well");
1663                        }
1664                }
1665
1666                float radiusWithMoons = planet.getRadius();
1667                if (addMoons) {
1668                        boolean hasOrbits = random.nextFloat() < planetData.getProbOrbits();
1669                        float min = planetData.getMinOrbits();
1670                        float max = planetData.getMaxOrbits();
1671//                      double r = random.nextFloat();
1672//                      r *= r;
1673//                      int numOrbits = (int) (min + Math.round((max - min) * r));
1674                        int numOrbits = (int) Math.round(getNormalRandom(min, max));
1675                        
1676//                      hasOrbits = true;
1677//                      numOrbits = 2;
1678                        
1679//                      if (numOrbits == 3) {
1680//                              System.out.println("efwefwefew");
