1810        protected void addStuffAtLagrangePoints(GenContext context, GeneratedPlanet planet) {
1811                float radius = planet.planet.getRadius();
1812                float probability = radius / 500f;
1813                if (radius < 150f) probability = 0f;
1814                if (planet.planet.isGasGiant()) probability = 1f;
1815                if (random.nextFloat() > probability) {
1816                        return;
1817                }
1818                
1819                // still a high chance to end up w/ nothing if cat_nothing is picked
1820                
1821//              int orbitIndex = context.orbitIndex;
1822//              String starType = context.star.getTypeId();
1823//              if (context.parentOrbitIndex >= 0) {
1824//                      orbitIndex = context.parentOrbitIndex;
1825//              }
1826                
1827                Set<LagrangePointType> points = EnumSet.of(LagrangePointType.L4, LagrangePointType.L5);
1828                for (LagrangePointType point : points) {
1829                        //CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData = pickCategory(orbitIndex, 0, starAge.name(), starType, context.parentCategory, COL_LAGRANGE, true);
1830                        CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData = pickCategory(context, COL_LAGRANGE, true);
1831                        if (categoryData != null && !CAT_NOTHING.equals(categoryData.getCategory())) {
1832                                //WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> picker = getPickerForCategory(categoryData, orbitIndex, 0, starAge.name(), starType, context.parentCategory, COL_LAGRANGE);
1833                                WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> picker = getPickerForCategory(categoryData, context, COL_LAGRANGE);
1834                                if (DEBUG) {
1835                                        picker.print("  Picking from category " + categoryData.getCategory() + 
1836                                                        ", orbit index " + (context.parent != null ? context.parentOrbitIndex : context.orbitIndex + ", for lagrange point"));
1837                                }
1838                                EntityGenDataSpec entityData = picker.pick();
1839                                if (DEBUG) {
1840                                        if (entityData == null) {
1841                                                System.out.println("  Nothing to pick");
1842                                                System.out.println();
1843                                        } else {
1844                                                System.out.println("  Picked: " + entityData.getId());
1845                                                System.out.println();
1846                                        }
1847                                }
1848                                
1849                                context.lagrangeParent = planet;
1850                                context.lagrangePointType = point;
1851                                
1852                                GenResult result = null;
1853                                if (entityData instanceof PlanetGenDataSpec) {
1854                                        PlanetGenDataSpec planetData = (PlanetGenDataSpec) entityData;
1855                                        result = addPlanet(context, planetData, true, true);
1856                                } else if (entityData instanceof TerrainGenDataSpec) {
1857                                        TerrainGenDataSpec terrainData = (TerrainGenDataSpec) entityData;
1858                                        result = addTerrain(context, terrainData);
1859                                }
1860                                
1861                                if (result != null) {
1862                                        for (SectorEntityToken curr : result.entities) {
1863                                                if (context.lagrangeParent != null && !result.entities.isEmpty()) {
1864                                                        lagrangeParentMap.put(curr, context.lagrangeParent.planet);
1865                                                }
1866                                                allNameableEntitiesAdded.put(curr, result.entities);
1867                                        }
1868                                }
1869                        }
1870                }
1871                context.lagrangeParent = null;
1872                context.lagrangePointType = null;
1873        }

1878        public CategoryGenDataSpec pickCategory(GenContext context, String extraMult, boolean nothingOk) {
1879//              int orbitIndex = context.orbitIndex;
1880//              if (context.parentOrbitIndex >= 0) {
1881//                      orbitIndex = context.parentOrbitIndex;
1882//              }
1883//              int fromParentOrbitIndex = context.orbitIndex;
1884                String age = context.age;
1885                //String starType = context.star.getTypeId();
1886                String starType = star != null ? star.getTypeId() : null;
1887                if (context.center instanceof PlanetAPI) {
1888                        PlanetAPI star = (PlanetAPI) context.center;
1889                        if (star.isStar()) starType = star.getTypeId();
1890                }
1891                
1892                String parentCategory = context.parentCategory;
1893                
1894                WeightedRandomPicker<CategoryGenDataSpec> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<CategoryGenDataSpec>(random);
1895                Collection<CategoryGenDataSpec> categoryDataSpecs = Global.getSettings().getAllSpecs(CategoryGenDataSpec.class);
1896                for (CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData : categoryDataSpecs) {
1897                        if (context.excludeCategories.contains(categoryData.getCategory())) continue;
1898                        
1899                        boolean catNothing = categoryData.getCategory().equals(CAT_NOTHING);
1900                        if (!nothingOk && catNothing) continue;
1901//                      if (categoryData.getCategory().equals("cat_terrain_rings")) {
1902//                              System.out.println("sdfkwefewfe");
1903//                      }
1904                        float weight = categoryData.getFrequency();
1905                        if (age != null) weight *= categoryData.getMultiplier(age);
1906                        if (starType != null) weight *= categoryData.getMultiplier(starType);
1907                        if (parentCategory != null) weight *= categoryData.getMultiplier(parentCategory);
1908                        for (String col : context.multipliers) {
1909                                weight *= categoryData.getMultiplier(col);
1910                        }
1911                        if (extraMult != null) weight *= categoryData.getMultiplier(extraMult);
1912                        
1913                        //if (weight > 0 && (catNothing || !isCategoryEmpty(categoryData, orbitIndex, fromParentOrbitIndex, age, starType, parentCategory, extraMult))) {
1914                        if (weight > 0 && (catNothing || !isCategoryEmpty(categoryData, context, extraMult, nothingOk))) {
1915                                picker.add(categoryData, weight); 
1916                        }
1917                }
1918                
1919                if (DEBUG) {
1920                        boolean withParent = context.parent != null;
1921                        int orbitIndex = context.orbitIndex;
1922                        String parentType = "";
1923                        if (withParent) {
1924                                parentType = context.parent.getSpec().getPlanetType();
1925                                orbitIndex = context.parentOrbitIndex;
1926                        }
1927                        
1928//                      float offset = orbitIndex;
1929//                      float minIndex = context.starData.getHabZoneStart() + planetData.getHabOffsetMin() + offset;
1930//                      float maxIndex = context.starData.getHabZoneStart() + planetData.getHabOffsetMax() + offset;
1931                        //boolean inRightRange = orbitIndex >= minIndex && orbitIndex <= maxIndex;
1932                        int habDiff = orbitIndex - (int) context.starData.getHabZoneStart();
1933                        if (withParent) {
1934                                picker.print("  Picking category for moon of " + parentType + 
1935                                                         ", orbit from star: " + orbitIndex + " (" + habDiff + ")" +  ", extra: " + extraMult);
1936                        } else {
1937                                picker.print("  Picking category for entity orbiting star " + starType + 
1938                                                        ", orbit from star: " + orbitIndex + " (" + habDiff + ")" +  ", extra: " + extraMult);
1939                        }
1940                }
1941                
1942                CategoryGenDataSpec pick = picker.pick();
1943                if (DEBUG) {
1944                        System.out.println("  Picked: " + pick.getCategory());
1945                        System.out.println();
1946                }
1947                
1948                return pick;
1949        }

1955        protected float getHabOffset(EntityGenDataSpec data) {
1956                if (starAge == StarAge.YOUNG) {
1957                        return data.getHabOffsetYOUNG();
1958                }
1959                if (starAge == StarAge.AVERAGE) {
1960                        return data.getHabOffsetAVERAGE();
1961                }
1962                if (starAge == StarAge.OLD) {
1963                        return data.getHabOffsetOLD();
1964                }
1965                return 0f;
1966        }

1970        protected WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> getPickerForCategory(CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData, 
1971                        GenContext context, String extraMult) {
1972                return getPickerForCategory(categoryData, context, extraMult, true);

1974        protected WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> getPickerForCategory(CategoryGenDataSpec categoryData, 
1975                                                                                                                                                   GenContext context, String extraMult, boolean nothingOk) {
1976                int orbitIndex = context.orbitIndex;
1977                if (context.parentOrbitIndex >= 0) {
1978                        orbitIndex = context.parentOrbitIndex;
1979                }
1980                int fromParentOrbitIndex = context.orbitIndex;
1981                String age = context.age;
1982                //String starType = context.star.getTypeId();
1983                String starType = star != null ? star.getTypeId() : null;
1984                if (context.center instanceof PlanetAPI) {
1985                        PlanetAPI star = (PlanetAPI) context.center;
1986                        if (star.isStar()) starType = star.getTypeId();
1987                }
1988                
1989                String parentCategory = context.parentCategory;
1990                
1991        
1992                WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<EntityGenDataSpec>(random);
1993                
1994                Collection<PlanetGenDataSpec> planetDataSpecs = Global.getSettings().getAllSpecs(PlanetGenDataSpec.class);
1995                for (PlanetGenDataSpec planetData : planetDataSpecs) {
1996                        if (!planetData.getCategory().equals(categoryData.getCategory())) continue;
1997                        
1998                        float offset = getHabOffset(planetData);
1999                        float minIndex = context.starData.getHabZoneStart() + planetData.getHabOffsetMin() + offset;
2000                        float maxIndex = context.starData.getHabZoneStart() + planetData.getHabOffsetMax() + offset;
2001                        boolean inRightRange = orbitIndex >= minIndex && orbitIndex <= maxIndex;
2002                        boolean giantMoonException = CAT_GIANT.equals(parentCategory) && 
2003                                                (planetData.hasTag(TAG_GIANT_MOON) && context.parent != null && context.parent.isGasGiant());
2004                        if (!inRightRange && !giantMoonException) continue;
2005                        
2006//                      if (planetData.getId().equals("rocky_unstable")) {
2007//                              System.out.println("dsfwefwefw");
2008//                      }
2009                        
2010                        boolean orbitIndexOk = fromParentOrbitIndex == 0 || !planetData.hasTag(TAG_FIRST_ORBIT_ONLY);
2011                        if (!orbitIndexOk) continue;
2012                        
2013                        boolean lagrangeStatusOk = COL_LAGRANGE.equals(extraMult) || !planetData.hasTag(TAG_LAGRANGE_ONLY);
2014                        if (!lagrangeStatusOk) continue;
2015                        
2016                        boolean nebulaStatusOk = NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType) || !planetData.hasTag(TAG_NOT_IN_NEBULA);
2017                        nebulaStatusOk &= !NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType) || !planetData.hasTag(TAG_REQUIRES_NEBULA);
2018                        nebulaStatusOk &= systemType != StarSystemType.NEBULA || !planetData.hasTag(TAG_NOT_NEBULA_UNLESS_MOON) || context.parent != null;
2019                        if (!nebulaStatusOk) continue;
2020                        
2021                        float weight = planetData.getFrequency();
2022                        if (age != null) weight *= planetData.getMultiplier(age);
2023                        if (starType != null) weight *= planetData.getMultiplier(starType);
2024                        if (parentCategory != null) weight *= planetData.getMultiplier(parentCategory);
2025                        for (String col : context.multipliers) {
2026                                weight *= planetData.getMultiplier(col);
2027                        }
2028                        if (extraMult != null) weight *= planetData.getMultiplier(extraMult);
2029                        if (weight > 0) picker.add(planetData, weight);
2030                }
2031                
2032                Collection<TerrainGenDataSpec> terrainDataSpecs = Global.getSettings().getAllSpecs(TerrainGenDataSpec.class);
2033                for (TerrainGenDataSpec terrainData : terrainDataSpecs) {
2034                        if (!terrainData.getCategory().equals(categoryData.getCategory())) continue;
2035                        
2036                        if (!nothingOk && terrainData.getId().equals("rings_nothing")) continue;
2037                        
2038                        float offset = getHabOffset(terrainData);
2039                        float minIndex = context.starData.getHabZoneStart() + terrainData.getHabOffsetMin() + offset;
2040                        float maxIndex = context.starData.getHabZoneStart() + terrainData.getHabOffsetMax() + offset;
2041                        boolean inRightRange = orbitIndex >= minIndex && orbitIndex <= maxIndex;
2042                        boolean giantMoonException = CAT_GIANT.equals(parentCategory) && 
2043                                                                (terrainData.hasTag(TAG_GIANT_MOON) && context.parent != null && context.parent.isGasGiant());
2044                        if (!inRightRange && !giantMoonException) continue;
2045                        
2046                        boolean orbitIndexOk = fromParentOrbitIndex == 0 || !terrainData.hasTag(TAG_FIRST_ORBIT_ONLY);
2047                        if (!orbitIndexOk) continue;
2048                        
2049                        boolean lagrangeStatusOk = COL_LAGRANGE.equals(extraMult) || !terrainData.hasTag(TAG_LAGRANGE_ONLY);
2050                        if (!lagrangeStatusOk) continue;
2051                        
2052                        boolean nebulaStatusOk = NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType) || !terrainData.hasTag(TAG_NOT_IN_NEBULA);
2053                        nebulaStatusOk &= !NEBULA_NONE.equals(nebulaType) || !terrainData.hasTag(TAG_REQUIRES_NEBULA);
2054                        nebulaStatusOk &= systemType != StarSystemType.NEBULA || !terrainData.hasTag(TAG_NOT_NEBULA_UNLESS_MOON) || context.parent != null;
2055                        if (!nebulaStatusOk) continue;
2056                        
2057                        float weight = terrainData.getFrequency();
2058                        if (age != null) weight *= terrainData.getMultiplier(age);
2059                        if (starType != null) weight *= terrainData.getMultiplier(starType);
2060                        if (parentCategory != null) weight *= terrainData.getMultiplier(parentCategory);
2061                        for (String col : context.multipliers) {
2062                                weight *= terrainData.getMultiplier(col);
2063                        }
2064                        if (extraMult != null) weight *= terrainData.getMultiplier(extraMult);
2065                        if (weight > 0) picker.add(terrainData, weight);
2066                }
2067                
2068                return picker;
2069        }

2073        protected void setDefaultLightColorBasedOnStars() {
2074                Color one = Color.white, two = null, three = null;
2075                
2076                switch (systemType) {
2077                case BINARY_FAR:
2078                case TRINARY_2FAR:
2079                case SINGLE:
2080                case NEBULA:
2081                        one = pickLightColorForStar(star);
2082                        break;
2083                case BINARY_CLOSE:
2084                case TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR:
2085                        one = pickLightColorForStar(star);
2086                        two = pickLightColorForStar(secondary);
2087                        break;
2088                case TRINARY_2CLOSE:
2089                        one = pickLightColorForStar(star);
2090                        two = pickLightColorForStar(secondary);
2091                        three = pickLightColorForStar(tertiary);
2092                        break;
2093                }
2094                
2095                Color result = one;
2096                if (two != null && three == null) {
2097                        result = Misc.interpolateColor(one, two, 0.5f);
2098                } else if (two != null && three != null) {
2099                        result = Misc.interpolateColor(one, two, 0.5f);
2100                        result = Misc.interpolateColor(result, three, 0.5f);
2101                }
2102                system.setLightColor(result); // light color in entire system, affects all entities
2103        }

2124        protected PlanetAPI addRandomStar(String id, String name) {
2125                PlanetSpecAPI starSpec = pickStar(constellationAge);
2126                if (starSpec == null) return null;
2127                
2128                StarGenDataSpec starData = (StarGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(StarGenDataSpec.class, starSpec.getPlanetType(), false);
2129                float radius = getRadius(starData.getMinRadius(), starData.getMaxRadius());
2130                
2131                float corona = radius * (starData.getCoronaMult() + starData.getCoronaVar() * (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f));
2132                if (corona < starData.getCoronaMin()) corona = starData.getCoronaMin();
2133                
2134                PlanetAPI star = system.addPlanet(id, // unique id for this star
2135                                                                                  null,
2136                                                                                  name,
2137                                                                                    starSpec.getPlanetType(),  // id in planets.json
2138                                                                                    0f,  // angle
2139                                                                                    radius,               // radius (in pixels at default zoom)
2140                                                                                    10000f, // orbit radius
2141                                                                                    1000f // orbit days
2142                                                                                        );
2143                
2144                system.addCorona(star, corona,  // corona radius, from star edge 
2145                                                   starData.getSolarWind(),
2146                                                   (float) (starData.getMinFlare() + (starData.getMaxFlare() - starData.getMinFlare()) * random.nextFloat()),
2147                                                   starData.getCrLossMult());
2148                
2149                return star;
2150        }

2271                Color color = new Color((int) (min.getRed() + (max.getRed() - min.getRed()) * random.nextDouble()),
2272                                (int) (min.getGreen() + (max.getGreen() - min.getGreen()) * random.nextDouble()),
2273                                (int) (min.getBlue() + (max.getBlue() - min.getBlue()) * random.nextDouble()),
2274                                255);
2275                
2276                return color;
2277        }

2285        public static float getNormalRandom(Random random, float min, float max) {
2286                double r = random.nextGaussian();
2287                r *= 0.2f;
2288                r += 0.5f;
2289                if (r < 0) r = 0;
2290                if (r > 1) r = 1;
2291                
2292                // 70% chance 0.3 < r < .7
2293                // 95% chance 0.1 < r < .7
2294                // 99% chance 0 < r < 1
2295                return min + (float) r * (max - min);
2296        }
